execution.corporate_actions: QD-010 known-at pre-effective risk exit and cash entitlements
execution.delayed_failure_or_time_exit: first row in the authoritative sell-legal open ledger strictly after completed trigger; may occur after H20 because of suspension/limit constraints, but never reads 2024+

failure_exits.X0_NO_FAILURE_EXIT: U within current attack or time stop
failure_exits.X1_INTRADAY_REJECTION: only after the position is T+1 sellable, two consecutive completed standard exchange-clock 15-minute closes below L and current z<=-0.25; morning blocks anchor at 09:30 and afternoon blocks at 13:00; next legal minute open
failure_exits.X2_ZONE_DAMAGE_05W: completed daily close<=L-0.50W; next legal open
failure_exits.X3_ZONE_DAMAGE_10W: completed daily close<=L-1.00W; next legal open
failure_exits.X4_NO_PROGRESS_D3: at D3, U unresolved, max progress<0.25W, daily close<L; next legal open
failure_exits.X5_STRUCTURAL_BREAK: new lower MAJOR/SECONDARY true gap or lower causal cluster; first legal execution after known

loss_statistics.CLEAN_SUCCESS_10: current-attack legal U within ten completed sessions before an 8% adverse mark
loss_statistics.CLEAN_SUCCESS_5: current-attack legal U within five completed sessions before a 5% adverse mark
loss_statistics.MAE: minimum same-lineage coordinate mark from entry through the actual exit
loss_statistics.MFE: maximum same-lineage coordinate mark from entry through the actual exit
loss_statistics.SEVERE_LOSS5_8_10_20: realized NET_RETURN <= -5%/-8%/-10%/-20%; MAE is reported separately

profit_target: legal U realization before the current attack's own reset; later U never credits the earlier attack

retry.R1_ONE_RETRY: ATTACK_2 independently passes the same frozen admission after ATTACK_1 ends and prior position closes
